name: Glute Bridge (Bodyweight)
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat on the floor hip-width apart.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips until knees, hips, and shoulders form a line.
Squeeze the glutes hard at the top for 1-2 seconds.
Lower with control. Keep the ribs down — don't overarch the lower back.
longevityNotes: A strong hinge is back insurance. Learn it light, groove it often, and add load slowly — the goal is a back that never complains about picking things up.
overview: A beginner bodyweight hinge-pattern exercise for the glutes. Glute Bridge (Bodyweight) builds posterior-chain strength that protects your back in everyday lifting.
